loki.role: ALL round-2 cells (r1-r6) and ALL timing. Deviation from the round-1 dual-host split: foureyes was unreachable (no live forwarded SSH agent socket and no local key at run time). Cell outcomes are deterministic and host-independent, and the timing baseline is required to be single-host loki, so the deviation does not affect comparability.

timing_policy: all 83 methods re-timed quietly (idle box, 24 workers, timing-only mode, 9 reps) so both rounds share one uncontended loki baseline; round-1 committed result JSONs retain their original contended timing and timing_quiet_summary.json supersedes them for throughput comparisons
mechanism: mechanism/ carries WH2 phase stacks + ablation ladder, WH1 phase stacks + dense/heavy ablations (dense/heavy override rows with ok=0 time FAILED constructions and bound cost only), five-method micro timing, and perf function profiles (kernel.perf_event_paranoid lowered to 1 via sudo for the session)
